# Mod WORK-IN-PROGRESS
Everyday, as you wake up, you find yourself different... as if an effect were applied, but you don't know what is it.
# Random Daily Quirk
## About
This Mod applies a new random subtle effect, not too OP and not too bad, just enough for a little boost or downgrade everyday, something to look out for.
some effects do stuff like a tiny speed boost, or 1 more heart, but also can be something like 1 less heart, or a bigger body.

## Credits
You are allowed to use this mod in your modpack without attribution (it would be nice tho)
## Feedback is Wanted
My Discord is at zayoon0o0
